comment: Per MASTER2 LLM.md — bash permitted for git/ruby/bundle invocations only. All other shell ops use zsh. rbenv added because every Rails/MASTER command has to go through it (see env.RBENV_VERSION). vm23 ssh/curl deliberately NOT here: settings.local.json already grants Bash(ssh *) personally, and this file is committed — production access belongs in a per-operator file, not one that ships to whoever clones.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */RAILS/*.scss) ruby /Users/mac/Documents/GitHub/pub4/RAILS/tools/build_all_css.rb;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */MASTER/web/public/face.part*.txt|*/MASTER/web/public/face_speech_*.js) cd /Users/mac/Documents/GitHub/pub4/MASTER/web && rbenv exec bundle exec rails assets:build_face_runtime;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
